songs.title: Where Can Animals Live? 🐪
lines: In the desert, hot and sandy,
Camels can live, yes, they can!
In the ocean, deep and chilly,
Fish can't live up on the land!
Can a squirrel live in a forest?
Yes, it can! It climbs the trees!
My favorite is the dolphin.
I like it because it's smart!
n: 곡조: Oh My Darling, Clementine (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
‘desert’에서 부채질, ‘ocean’에서 헤엄치기, ‘forest’에서 나무 오르기 동작을 하고, 마지막 줄에서 좋아하는 동물 흉내를 냅니다.
songs.imgPrompt: A camel walking across a sandy desert, fish swimming in a blue ocean, a squirrel climbing a forest tree, and a smiling dolphin leaping from the waves.

songs.title: Same or Different? 🦓
lines: Zebras and horses — are they the same?
Both horses and zebras eat grass!
Zebras have stripes, but horses don't!
Similar? Different? Let's compare!
Both lions and tigers are majestic!
Lions have manes, but tigers have stripes!
However, they live in different places!
Hear them roar with strength and courage!
n: 곡조: Rap chant (4 beats) — 멜로디 없이 4박으로 읊는 챈트, 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
‘Both’에서 두 손을 모으고, ‘but / however’에서 두 손을 양쪽으로 벌려 ‘다르다’를 표현하며 무릎 박자로 랩합니다.
songs.imgPrompt: A zebra and a horse grazing side by side on grass, with a lion on a grassland and a striped tiger in a jungle roaring proudly.

songs.title: The Fastest, the Best! 🏆
lines: The cheetah is the fastest cat,
The whale is the heaviest,
The strangest pet? An iguana!
The most exotic!
Today's the best day of my life,
My puppy is the cutest!
Good, better, best! Bad, worse, worst!
Yay! It's the best day!
n: 곡조: Pop Goes the Weasel (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
각 절 마지막 줄(‘The most exotic!’, ‘Yay! It's the best day!’)에서 ‘Pop!’처럼 화면 앞으로 튀어 오르며 외칩니다.
songs.imgPrompt: A cheetah sprinting, a huge whale swimming, a child holding a friendly iguana, and a happy child hugging a cute puppy on a sunny day.
